name: Tanushree Chakraborty
bio: Tanusree Chakraborty is an Indian film actress who is known for her work in the Bengali film and TV industries. The actress who made her debut with Bondhu Eso Tumi (2010) rose to fame with her role in Uro Chithi (2011) and few of her other popular films include Basanta Utsab (2013), Buno Haansh (2014), Ichchhemotir Gappo (2015), Chorabali (2016), Druga Sohay (2017), Gumnaami (2019), Zombiesthaan (2019) and Deep Fridge (2024).
